title: RiboDFM: Robust RNA sequence design using backbone-conditioned discrete flow matching
authors: Liu X; An X; Peng Z; Wang W; Yang J
one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于骨架条件的离散流匹配框架RiboDFM用于RNA序列设计，虽对象为RNA而非蛋白质，但其结构条件序列生成与置信度评估方法可迁移至蛋白质结构计算，具有借鉴价值。
abstract:
Design:

ing RNA sequences that fold into predefined 3D structures is central to RNA engineering, yet it remains challenging due to the scarcity of experimentally determined structures and the complex sequence-structure relationships. Here, we present RiboDFM, a backbone-conditioned discrete flow-matching framework for RNA sequence design. RiboDFM progressively resolves fully masked sequences by integrating a geometric backbone encoder, an auxiliary base-pairing prediction head, and language model representations into a discrete flow sampler. To expand our training data, we supplemented experimental structures with a large-scale collection of trRosettaRNA2-predicted models. Across diverse benchmarks, RiboDFM achieves high sequence recovery and generates sequences with greater tertiary-structure self-consistency than existing methods. RiboDFM also performs strongly on aptamer-focused design tasks. Finally, beyond sequence generation, the nucleotide probabilities derived from RiboDFM' s flow trajectory serve as an intrinsic measure of sequence-structure compatibility. This enables reliable confidence estimation for designed sequences, as well as reference-free, zero-shot assessment of predicted structure models. Together, these results establish RiboDFM as an effective framework for structure-based RNA sequence design.
abstract_zh:
设计：

将RNA序列折叠成预定义的3D结构是RNA工程的核心，但由于实验确定结构的稀缺性和复杂的序列-结构关系，这仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出RiboDFM，一种用于RNA序列设计的骨架条件离散流匹配框架。RiboDFM通过将几何骨架编码器、辅助碱基配对预测头和语言模型表示整合到离散流采样器中，逐步解析完全掩蔽的序列。为扩展训练数据，我们用大规模trRosettaRNA2预测模型补充了实验结构。在多个基准测试中，RiboDFM实现了高序列恢复率，并生成比现有方法具有更高三级结构自一致性的序列。RiboDFM在适配体聚焦的设计任务中也表现强劲。最后，除序列生成外，从RiboDFM流轨迹导出的核苷酸概率可作为序列-结构兼容性的内在度量。这为设计序列提供了可靠的置信度估计，以及对预测结构模型的无参考、零样本评估。综合这些结果，RiboDFM确立为基于结构的RNA序列设计的有效框架。
